summary: Both editions were reviewed independently against every clause of the selected working Greek. No concrete fidelity defect was identified. Both preserve the two parables, seasonal contrasts, visibility assertions, distinct burning reasons, full negative outcomes, and conditional fruit-bearing statements. Serve and repent follow current contextual policy. The notes distinguish the selected readings from reported alternatives, identify the bracketed IV.6 connection as an editorial insertion, and qualify supplied papyrus wording and the bounded IV.3 selection. Acceptance concerns the supplied text and attributed evidence reports only; it does not authenticate unseen manuscripts or editions, establish a unique interpretation, or certify exhaustive collation.
